title: The company is said to be…

questions.context: A spokesperson says the company expects to reopen on Monday; an inspection is still pending
questions.prompt: Which report preserves the status of the claim?

options.text: The company is expected to reopen on Monday, subject to inspection
The company has been cleared to reopen on Monday

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: An expectation is not completed clearance

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: An expectation is not completed clearance

questions.context: A newspaper reports that a new manager has been appointed; the organisation has not confirmed it
questions.prompt: Which wording keeps the source visible?

options.text: A new manager has definitely taken over, as officially confirmed
The newspaper reports that a new manager has been appointed

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Attribute an unconfirmed report instead of upgrading it to fact

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Attribute an unconfirmed report instead of upgrading it to fact

questions.context: “Three employees are believed to have witnessed the incident”

options.text: Whether the writer is referring to a future incident
Whether those employees actually witnessed it

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Are believed to marks the report as a belief

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Are believed to marks the report as a belief

questions.context: The committee has publicly confirmed its decision
questions.prompt: Which formulation reports that without unnecessary hedging?

options.text: The committee has confirmed that the proposal was approved
It is vaguely rumoured that the committee may have met

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Confirmed evidence supports a clear attributed statement

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Confirmed evidence supports a clear attributed statement

questions.context: An audit is being carried out, but no findings have been published
questions.prompt: Which update avoids inventing a result?

options.text: The review has proved that the figures are wrong
The figures are being reviewed; no conclusion has been released

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: An investigation in progress does not establish its outcome

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: An investigation in progress does not establish its outcome

questions.context: You’re writing a neutral summary of a disputed claim

options.text: Identify who made the claim and distinguish it from verified findings
Use a passive reporting phrase to make every allegation sound settled

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Reporting structures must not erase the difference between a claim and a finding

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Reporting structures must not erase the difference between a claim and a finding

phrases.displayText: This post says the café is closing permanently. Would you share it?
phrases.translation: Esta postagem diz que o café vai fechar definitivamente. Você compartilharia?

phrases.displayText: Not as it stands. It doesn’t identify the source of that claim
phrases.translation: Não desse jeito. Não identifica a fonte dessa afirmação

phrases.displayText: The café is said to be closing, then? That sounds more cautious
phrases.translation: Então dizem que o café vai fechar? Parece mais cauteloso

phrases.displayText: Grammatically, yes, but it still passes on the claim without telling us who said it
phrases.translation: Gramaticalmente, sim, mas ainda repassa a alegação sem dizer quem falou

phrases.displayText: The official notice says the dining area will close for renovation while delivery continues
phrases.translation: O aviso oficial diz que o salão fechará para reforma enquanto as entregas continuam

phrases.displayText: That confirms a temporary change in service, not the permanent end of the business
phrases.translation: Isso confirma uma mudança temporária no serviço, não o fim definitivo do negócio

phrases.displayText: Does it give a reopening date?
Not in this excerpt. We should check rather than turn an expectation into a date
phrases.translation: Não neste trecho. Devemos conferir em vez de transformar expectativa em data

phrases.displayText: So I could say, according to the café’s notice, the dining area is closing for renovation
phrases.translation: Então posso dizer: segundo o aviso do café, o salão vai fechar para reforma

phrases.displayText: Yes, and keep the delivery detail because it changes what readers need to do
phrases.translation: Sim, e mantenha o detalhe das entregas porque muda o que o público precisa fazer

phrases.displayText: I’d also correct the permanent-closure claim if I’d already shared it
phrases.translation: Eu também corrigiria a alegação de fechamento definitivo se já a tivesse compartilhado

phrases.displayText: Exactly. Cautious wording doesn’t remove the responsibility to check and correct
phrases.translation: Exatamente. Uma formulação cautelosa não elimina a responsabilidade de verificar e corrigir
